## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* Yuán-period revision by **Yúnwài Zìqìng** 雲外自慶 of the *qīngguī* 清規 (pure-rules) monastic regulations for Tiāntái-school institutions (*jiàoyuàn* 教苑 — "doctrinal gardens," the Tiāntái-school monastic designation distinguishing them from Chán-school institutions).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within the Yuán productive period (1271–1368). The work belongs to the broader medieval Buddhist *qīngguī* tradition that includes the foundational *[百丈清規](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E7%99%BE%E4%B8%88%E6%B8%85%E8%A6%8F)* of Chán Buddhism and parallel monastic regulations for the various Buddhist schools.
